name: Foreman Stonebrow
summary: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, Foreman Stonebrow faces a trogg attack that has driven miners from the pits. He speaks for the Miners' League and now needs help defending the excavation.

sections.title: The Crisis at Gol'Bolar
sections.body: Foreman Stonebrow directs the Miners' League's work at Gol'Bolar Quarry, east of Kharanos. Deep digging broke into trogg burrows beneath the quarry, and the creatures swarmed the pits, driving miners from their tools. Stonebrow remains at the quarry rim, seeking travelers willing to push the troggs back.

faq.answer: Foreman Stonebrow oversees the Miners' League's work at Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. He coordinates the digging and works to keep the site secure.

faq.q: Why is Foreman Stonebrow asking for help?
faq.answer: The digging broke into trogg caverns beneath Gol'Bolar Quarry. Troggs swept across the lower terraces, killing workers and driving the surviving miners back to the camp at the rim.
The Miners' League is a dwarven guild and trade organization based in Ironforge. It oversees mining expeditions, resource gathering, and quarry work throughout Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Where can Foreman Stonebrow be found?
faq.answer: Foreman Stonebrow is at the camp on the rim of Gol'Bolar Quarry, in eastern Dun Morogh, just off the road to Loch Modan.

angles.text: For a dwarf, the trogg attack on Gol'Bolar Quarry strikes at Ironforge's stone industry and recalls the ancient dangers beneath dwarven lands.
As a miner, you have a stake in helping Stonebrow reclaim the quarry's stone and ore deposits, vital to Khaz Modan's guild operations.
